chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Zurārah ibn Aʿyan, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection as a community by himself; upon him will be the mark of the Prophets and the awe of kings.

key_terms.أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً: as a distinct community by himself
key_terms.سِيمَاءُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the identifying mark or appearance of the Prophets
key_terms.عَبْدُ الْمُطَّلِبِ: ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, the grandfather of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.هَيْبَةُ الْمُلُوكِ: the awe, majesty, and dignity of kings

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the status of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the exalted rank of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib on the Day of Resurrection. It portrays him as being raised with a unique distinction, bearing the signs of the Prophets and the majesty of kings, indicating exceptional honor and dignity.
